chunks: Let them worship the Lord of this House,

key_terms.الْبَيْتِ: The House (referring to the Kaaba in Mecca)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Lord of the House in Surah Quraysh?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Quraysh, this verse underscores the theological principle that political and economic stewardship of the Kaaba by the Quraysh was contingent upon their exclusive worship of its Lord, Allah. Shia exegetes often highlight this as a reminder that temporal authority and sacred custodianship are meaningless without sincere monotheism (Tawhid), linking the physical sanctuary to the spiritual obligation of servitude to the Divine.
